**The orchestrator's acceptance (D-133 / D-138).** The reservation adds one synchronous metadata transaction before the ruleset install on Steps that queue conntrack deletes: about 1.1 ms at p50 and 1.59 ms at p99 (direct benchmark, 240 samples), confirmed inside the existing pre-Apply bracket on every B leg (1.03–1.17 ms against 0.01–0.03 ms on A). The same-host A,B,A,B (plus a live-only repeat) passed 12 / 12 tests with 6 legs qualified at entry and exit; pooled per arm across windows (D-138), there is no B-only failure and no attributable regression or improvement in the guard distributions. The measured cost is accepted as the price of a crash-safe 12-attempt bound; it is outside the D-104 render / install / guard interval, and pure renewal or expiry Steps without queued revocations add nothing. Isolation and members carry it into their assembled timelines (routed items 1–2).
